summary: This episode covers major geopolitical shifts including Europe's joint warning on China in the Taiwan Strait and Kremlin denials regarding Belarusian involvement in Ukraine. Scientific breakthroughs feature JWST's discovery of chemically mature galaxies 300-500 million years after the Big Bang, challenging star formation models, alongside new catalysts for ammonia production and solar-driven protein synthesis. The tech sector sees IBM's sub-1nm chip announcement, OpenAI's custom inference chip and massive compute deal, and EU regulatory moves designating cloud giants as gatekeepers. Economic data shows rising inflation complicating Fed rate cuts, while market volatility hits tech and crypto stocks. Cultural highlights include the premiere of House of the Dragon Season 3 and new seasons of Avatar and The Vampire Lestat.
